Edit reference capsule into animation frame 2 of 6. Keep exact canvas, position, sphere size, rendering and identity. 512x512 true transparent PNG. Edit reference into opening animation frame 4 of 6. Edit reference into final capsule opening animation frame 6 of 6. Exact 512x512 transparent canvas. Keep fully opened pink lid with white bunny emblem and mint bowl exactly at same positions, size and orientation as reference. Golden bloom now settles: reduce intensity of the gold glow substantially to a soft transparent warm light above bowl, rays vanish, just two tiny fading sparkles.
